{{Quote|I was working in the consular gardens and I found a datacard hidden in the main planter. Well, I knew it shouldn't be there, and I tried to return it to the chief of the household staff. As I was doing so, a strange man approached me, said he was with Imperial Intelligence, and told me I was under arrest.|Spero|<ref name="SF">{{WEGCite|story=Spero's Flight|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Imperial Intelligence agent''' once caught the [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] [[Spero]] in possession of a [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] belonging to undercover [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[operative]]s while at the [[Alderaanian Embassy|Alderaan consulate]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The agent attempted to arrest Spero, who resisted and fled into hiding with assistance from [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]].
